claims.title: Dependency-requiring training improves useful long-context capability
claims.question: Does targeted supervision improve document/history reasoning while retaining general ability?
claims.decision_rule: R2 paired training effect, multiplicity-aware inference and frozen general/per-family guardrails; null or adverse result keeps standard recipe.
planned_outputs: paired training effects and general retention
paper_sections: Dependency-requiring training improves useful long-context capability

claims.title: Architecture and supervision have a measured interaction
claims.question: Does the training effect differ between dense and hybrid memory architectures?
claims.decision_rule: R2 complete three-seed blocks with paired interaction intervals and adjusted testing; R3 only supports its measured scope. No significant effect means unresolved, not independence.
planned_outputs: one transfer comparison and its limits
paper_sections: Architecture and supervision have a measured interaction

claims.title: The released model delivers useful long-context quality at measured cost
claims.question: Does the 1.2B release improve a quality-cost operating point against named public or retrieval alternatives?
claims.decision_rule: Both primary-family useful-quality floors, general guardrails, final sealed audit, public/RAG comparisons and qualified serving must pass. Before/after stages do not establish dense 1.2B causal superiority.
planned_outputs: quality versus state and task latency
paper_sections: The released model delivers useful long-context quality at measured cost
